title: Authorization access matrix for Cloudron groups
summary: PHPUnit now covers the Cloudron access table end to end: public, volunteer, student, staff, administrator, and super-admin, including alias names that map to canonical myapesaccount groups.
changes: Add an authorization HTTP and Gate matrix for guest through super-admin service, delete, Admin Users, and Super Admin Access outcomes.
Cover canonical myapesaccount.superadmin plus legacy alias mapping without treating myapes.superadmin and myapes.superadmins as two live groups.
Confirm directory user sync rematerializes canonical groups and never creates identity_type=local public users.
version_rationale: Patch release: adds PHPUnit coverage for the existing access model without changing protected roles or live Cloudron group names.
validation: PHPUnit AuthorizationAccessMatrixTest, DirectoryRoleSynchronizerTest, DirectoryUserSynchronizerTest, and AdminAccessAndViewsTest are green.
Canonical myapesaccount.* groups and alias-to-canonical mapping are covered without creating a second live superadmin group.
Ran php artisan myapes:changelog-validate against the Access admin parent branch for this stacked change.
known_limitations: The matrix uses local/testing QA session provenance for HTTP actors; production Staff Login remains Cloudron OIDC.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version. Runtime authorization behaviour is unchanged; only tests and release metadata are removed.
provenance: Defined by the authorization access matrix task for MyAPES Account issue #98 under epic #91 and pull request #156.
